title: Rhetorical InDEX Instrument Alpha Contracts
description: Single canonical cross-language contract source. The `properties` enum lists are the canonical controlled vocabulary shared by TypeScript (packages/schema/src/contracts.ts, packages/schema/src/localPreviewContract.ts) and Python (services/rhetoric/vocabulary.py, services/api/detector_contract.py). The `$defs` object contracts declare required fields per core domain object. tests/vocabulary-parity.test.mjs, tests/python/test_vocabulary_parity.py and tests/python/unit/test_schema_contracts.py fail if any language drifts from this file. The full 12-mechanism id list is canonical in packages/taxonomy/taxonomy.json and is deliberately NOT duplicated here.

pressureLevel.description: Ordinal, mechanism-specific interpretive pressure. NOT factuality, NOT confidence, NOT harm.

confidenceLevel.description: Detector certainty that the mechanism is present. Epistemic only; independent of pressure.

voiceClass.description: Whose rhetoric this is. quoted_speaker must not be silently attributed to the outlet.

intrinsicAlphaSlice.description: The bounded four-mechanism subset the Level 2 Local Preview and Level 3 Instrument Alpha detectors are scoped to. Every id must also exist in packages/taxonomy/taxonomy.json.

passageType.description: Document structure is preserved, not flattened into one whitespace-collapsed blob.

analysisRunStatus.description: processing/complete/partial/failed. UI must derive scan state from this and never independently invent a completion label.

detectorProviderKind.description: mock = deterministic test double; heuristic = rule-based, unbenchmarked; model = external model provider (requires credentials, not exercised without them).

alignmentRelation.description: Claim-to-claim relation. `uncertain` and `unrelated` must survive; nothing may be silently forced into `same_proposition`.

authenticityState.description: Primary evidence is NOT automatically true. Default for unretrieved/unchecked material is `unverified`.

sourceDependenceType.description: `unknown` is the honest default. Ten articles repeating one wire story are not ten independent reports.

findingRule.const: one finding = one mechanism on one exact span

Passage.description: Canonical addressable unit of an article. Span coordinates in Findings are passage-local.

Article.description: contentHash is SHA-256 over canonical normalized text; identical canonical input yields an identical hash.

Finding.description: One Finding = one mechanism on one exact span. `mechanisms` (plural) is a prohibited legacy field.

AnalysisRun.description: Created before analysis begins. Every Finding references exactly one run. Coverage is explicit, never inferred.

DetectorFailure.description: Rejection record. Malformed detector output produces a DetectorFailure, never a cosmetically repaired Finding.

Claim.description: Atomic proposition used as the unit of cross-source comparison.

ClaimAlignment.description: Alignment confidence must propagate downstream; a weak match may not become a strong omission.

EvidenceItem.description: authenticityState is never globally set to `verified` without a stated basis.

MaterialOmission.description: Cross-document only. May never be emitted by an intrinsic single-article scan.

ComparisonSet.description: provenanceKind distinguishes synthetic fixture material from real retrieved coverage.

SourceDependency.description: Independence must not be assumed; `unknown` is the default.
